temporal_definition: Questions about time: dates, times, durations, intervals, or temporal relationships. Ordinary implementation changes do not qualify by themselves.
multihop_definition: Answers combine multiple facts and may depend on other question answers; the underlying source evidence remains attached and explicit dependencies are recorded separately.
